result:
**Verdict: PASS.** I raised no new findings, and my open finding F-DG5-140 is now CLOSED_VERIFIED.

The candidate checked out: `sha256:55a411ae…24ce` (2207 files) on a complete clone at both 660f40c and 7a02e7d, and in the repository working tree. The ID was the same again at the end of the run. The only commits that landed during the run were the other two reviewers' run records; I did not open them.

**F-DG5-140 (Low): verified closed**
- **Original reproduction:** I re-ran my round-1 reproduction and inspected all 62 PDF, DOCX, XLSX and PPTX samples. At branding version 0, all 31 Arabic files carry «منصة موبايلي للتحوّل» and never the English name; all 31 English files are the reverse; every header is in the file's language.
- **Real stack:** on the demo stack with the built worker process running, exports requested over HTTP and downloaded show the correct name in both languages, in both locale settings.
- **Mutant that undoes the fix:** the candidate's `branding.test.ts` fails. My inspection flags all 31 Arabic files and no English files. The real-stack check fails with exactly 6 problems, all on Arabic files.
- **One gap in coverage:** the A15 suite in `tests/qa` still passes with the fix undone, so it would not catch this regression. Only the implementer's `branding.test.ts` and `labels.test.ts` do. I recorded this as an observation, not a finding.

**Full review: every check this round passed**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Static (typecheck, build, lint, OpenAPI lint, no-CDN, format, contrast) | 7/7 pass |
| Unit (Node 22 and 24, locale unset and C.UTF-8) | 2366 / 1746 / 259 passed (+2 skipped by design) in each of the 4 runs |
| Integration, run twice | 321 files, 3087 passed + 1 skipped by design, each run; migrations 0001–0097; contract test 83/83 (846 operations); every `p5-pending` list empty |
| `tests/qa` on its own | 336/336 and 22/22 |
| REQ-DLV-037 counts | A06 27, A07 12, A15 34, A16 30 |
| Product e2e, C.UTF-8 | 470/470 |
| Product e2e, locale unset | 462 passed; 3 hit the 30 s timeout (no assertion failed); those 3 spec files pass alone, 42/42 |
| Root acceptance specs | 30/30 in each locale setting |
| Demo specs | 12/12 in each locale setting |
| My probes | auditor read-only pass with axe, 390 px and 200 % text 84/84 in each setting; REQ-PB-093 Studio path 4/4; demo probes 8/8 in each setting; executive-pack provisional label 3/3; Arabic text with control characters exports as valid DOCX, PPTX and XLSX on the real stack |
| Gate validators | 6/6 pass (`--register DG5`, `--pipeline`, `--historical` DG4/DG3/DG2/DG1) |

All 78 requirements are verified with this round's evidence. The environmental residuals (live registry, live CI, Keycloak/demo IdP, AI and notification adapters) are recorded as PASS on the offline/config surface, as the assignment asks.

**Failures in my logs, all kept and explained in `RUN-NOTES.md`:**
- **3 product e2e timeouts (locale unset):** the machine load peaked at about 25 with three reviews running at once. The same tests pass alone and in the C.UTF-8 run. One of them, p4-benefits test 8, took 27.4 s even alone, close to its 30 s limit. This is the same timing issue the earlier branch carried to DG6 as F-DG5-145/146.
- **Node 22 unit run, first attempt:** exited 1 with every test passing. Vitest's own internal timeout ("Timeout calling onTaskUpdate") fired under load. The re-run was clean.
- **My own harness error:** my first start of integration run 1 and the product e2e used `nohup` and was killed when the shell call ended. No results came from it, and both were re-run in full.
- **Probe errors (mine):** three of my probes had bugs: the demo label comes before the name on a PPTX title slide, my reader missed XLSX text cells, and an Arabic PDF's first text piece is a lone glyph. Each was fixed and re-run.

**Other notes:**
- I could not delete the 618 temporary directories (about 90 MB) that the integration tests left in my run's scratch space; the permission classifier refused the cleanup. The runner removes that space when the run ends.
- The task ID differs between the invocation (`T-DG5-RG2-QA-R2`) and the assignment text (`T-DG5-REV-QA-R5`). I used the invocation reference exactly as given.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-2/`:
- `qa-verifier.json` (validates against the review schema)
- `qa-verifier.verifications.json`
- `qa-verifier.md`

Evidence is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/round-2/` (start with `RUN-NOTES.md`). My test files are in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/tests/round-2/`.
